title: Cipher Anagram Search
description: You are given two text strings, p and s. Return true if s contains a permutation of p, or false otherwise. In other words, return true if one of p's permutations is a substring of s.
constraints: p and s consist of lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: s contains one permutation of p ("ba"), which is a substring.
s does not contain any permutation of p as a substring.
s contains the permutation "cda" which is a substring of s.
